messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Lattice perturbation search optimizing exact triple-area minimums

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration is a Z/13 × Z/1 lattice (equally spaced points along a horizontal line at y=1/2) symmetrically perturbed into two staggered rows: 7 points at y = 1/2 − δ and 6 points at y = 1/2 + δ, with x-coordinates following a two-interleaved-arithmetic-progressions pattern. Under continuous optimization of the 26 coordinates (initialized from this perturbed lattice), the bottleneck triple-area objective is piecewise-linear with breakpoints at equality of two candidate minimum-area triangles, so a simplex-based active-set method converging through these breakpoints yields a locally optimal minimum triangle area of exactly 1/132."}
